definitions.explanation: A horizontal line drawn through text to indicate deletion or correction. Used in both handwritten documents and digital text formatting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{消|け}し{線|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I drew a strikethrough line on the incorrect part.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{消|け}し{線|せん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二重線|にじゅうせん}→二重線：10288_nijuusen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please draw the deletion line as a double line.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワープロ→ワープロ：01544_waapuro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取|と}り{消|け}し{線|せん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書式|しょしき}→書式：15840_shoshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me how to set strikethrough formatting in the word processor.

notes:
In formal Japanese documents (especially official forms), mistakes are corrected by drawing a ⟦{二重線|にじゅうせん}→二重線：10288_nijuusen⟧ (double line) through the error and stamping the correction with a personal seal (⟦{訂正印|ていせいいん}→訂正印：10287_teiseiin⟧). Simple erasure is not acceptable on official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{消|け}し{線|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ — to draw a strikethrough
- ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧{取|と}り{消|け}し{線|せん} — double strikethrough
- {取|と}り{消|け}し{線|せん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ — to cross out with a strikethrough

RELATED WORDS:
- {取|と}り{消|け}し — cancellation
- ⟦{訂正|ていせい}→訂正：16493_teisei⟧ — correction
- ⟦{二重線|にじゅうせん}→二重線：10288_nijuusen⟧ — double line
